label: Riff
phrase: built around one instantly memorable guitar riff that returns as the main hook
a single sticky riff carries the whole track

label: Ligne de basse
phrase: built around a menacing, memorable bassline that leads the track
an unforgettable bass figure is the hook

label: Pattern batterie
phrase: the drum pattern itself is the hook, recognizable from the first bar
a signature drum groove you recognize instantly

label: Boucle
phrase: built around a short hypnotic loop that never lets go
one magnetic loop repeated until it becomes a world

label: Montée
phrase: the hook is the rise itself, a tension curve you want to hear again
memorability comes from the build and its release

label: Texture-monde
phrase: an immediately recognizable sound-world, a texture that announces a place
a distinctive sonic environment is the hook from second one

label: Motif mélodique
phrase: a simple magnetic melodic motif, few notes, the right sound
a short lead motif with a unique timbre, voiced by one instrument
